verdict.rationale: Omarchy is a full Linux desktop OS, not a terminal layer for another host. The only relevant evidence is one line saying all of Omarchy can run in a virtual machine "so you can get a taste first", which frames VM use as a trial rather than a supported development setup. The Windows-in-Docker VM runs in the opposite direction (Windows inside Omarchy) and earns no credit. Missing for 10: documented setup for running Omarchy inside a host OS (VM image, WSL-style integration, or host requirements), host/guest file and terminal integration, positioning as a development environment, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run a full Linux terminal environment inside another host OS for development and tooling

citations.quote: All of Omarchy running in a virtual machine, so you can get a taste first.
